items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: I didn't see them much. I remember two boys Boise and another boy.

ctx.x: I didn't see them much. I remember two boys Boise and another boy. We got so many different kinds of issues right now. You see those boarding people, you know, kind of savage. They come through the origin kind of horn, you know. They make good music like them, how are you? They make good music with them.
Boise was one or who's the other one?
